Specify concept-extraction options

Source: R/pipeline_options.R
concept_options.Rd

Select concept layers and configure packaged, user-defined, and external concepts.

Usage

concept_options(
  user_concepts = NULL,
  user_schema = NULL,
  external_sql_dir = NULL,
  external_schema = NULL,
  concept_name = NULL,
  dry_run = FALSE,
  layers = NULL,
  rm_duplicates = TRUE
)

Arguments

user_concepts

Character string giving a supplemental concept CSV. Rows override packaged definitions with the same source and concept name and may add new concepts. Default: NULL.

user_schema

Character string naming the target schema for user SQL. NULL uses the source concepts schema.

external_sql_dir

Character string giving an external SQL directory. NULL uses the project's configured external-concept directory.

external_schema

Character string naming the target schema for a single external module. NULL derives the schema from the module name. Separate submodules always receive separate schemas.

concept_name

Character vector of concept names or SQL filenames without the .sql extension. Filters the flat, ts, dur, and user layers. NULL includes all concepts in those layers; the ehr and external layers are not filtered.

dry_run

Logical. Generate or read concept SQL without building concept tables or registering provenance. Default: FALSE. This setting applies to concept extraction; it does not preview other pipeline stages. See run_concepts() for connection and file-writing behavior.

layers

Character vector selecting "flat", "ts", "dur", "ehr", "user", or "external". NULL selects all enabled layers. Layers run in this order; prerequisite tables must already exist. The ehr layer requires PostgreSQL.

rm_duplicates

Logical. Remove chart rows that are validated copies of lab results (MIMIC) or of monitor values (eICU) during ts/dur concept extraction, and repeated chart rows of a ts concept. Default: TRUE. FALSE extracts exactly the same rows and removes none. See run_atomic_concepts_unified() for the matching rule.

Value

A named list of the supplied options, suitable for the concepts argument of run_one_source() and compatible direct stage functions.

Details

In this package, ehr selects maintained SQL definitions. Upstream repo SQL is retained as reference material and cannot be selected for execution.

Only explicitly supplied arguments are included in the result, including explicit NULL values. Omitted settings use the defaults of the receiving function. An empty options list therefore leaves its defaults unchanged.

See also

pipeline_options, run_one_source()

Examples

concept_options(layers = "flat")
#> $layers
#> [1] "flat"
#> 
concept_options(layers = c("ts", "dur"), dry_run = TRUE)
#> $dry_run
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $layers
#> [1] "ts"  "dur"
#>
